claim.value: Draft saves alone may fit several explanations.
claim.scope: Draft-save evidence considered without additional discriminating observations.

provenance.rationale: The span explicitly identifies draft saves alone as compatible with multiple explanations.

signal_basis.value: Account-level event inspection reveals draft saves, considered alone rather than alongside evidence distinguishing the competing explanations.
signal_basis.scope: Isolated draft-save evidence on the path to first publication.

provenance.rationale: P006 supplies inspection of account-level draft-save events; P021 supplies their isolated, non-discriminating interpretation.
The supported judgment requires no unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: A draft save records intermediate activity without establishing why publication has not occurred. It can coexist with multiple explanations, so the modest claim of possible ambiguity is licensed.
uncertainty: The isolated event does not establish which explanation applies or their relative plausibility; the claim asserts neither.
